overloadMerges.note: Gives the 'name' overload its own semanticRole/discriminatedBy instead of the generic role shared verbatim with the 'id' overload.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of process for which to retrieve the process number
If passed, retrieve from a remote 4D the number of a process executing on the server (returned value is negative, unless executed with * from the server machine itself).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Looks up a running process by its process name and returns its process number, or 0 if no matching process is found.

discriminatedBy.rule: Intended lookup key is a process name (not statically distinguishable from the 'id' overload -- both take a single required Text argument; which overload applies depends on the caller's intent, not on the argument's declared type).

overloadMerges.note: Gives the 'id' overload its own semanticRole/discriminatedBy.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of process for which to retrieve the process number
If passed, retrieve from a remote 4D the number of a process executing on the server (returned value is negative, unless executed with * from the server machine itself).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Looks up a running process by its unique process ID (as returned by Process info's "ID" property) and returns its process number, or 0 if no matching process is found.

discriminatedBy.rule: Intended lookup key is a process ID (not statically distinguishable from the 'name' overload -- both take a single required Text argument; which overload applies depends on the caller's intent, not on the argument's declared type).

constraints: The optional * flag retrieves, from a remote 4D machine, the number of a process executing on the server; the returned value is then negative, unless the command is executed with * from the server machine itself, in which case it is positive.
Returns 0 if no process is found matching the given name or id.
